purpose: Revised 3-card candidate sample for CET4 listening box 0032 after the existing sample was blocked by agent self-review.

source_policy.source_note: Uses legacy content_pool transcripts with unverified provenance as simulated training material. Do not label as true exam content.

front.text: 听完后，选出 Friday noon 的作用。
front.task_prompt: 看到 by 要先想到截止点；时间要和 submitted 这个动作一起记。

options.text: It is the deadline for submitting the budget forms.
It is when the review meeting begins.
It is when the forms will be printed.
It is when the budget will be announced.

task_schema.focus: by Friday noon 与 submitted 的截止关系
task_schema.success_criteria: 能说明 Friday noon 是预算表提交截止点，而不是 review 开始或其他事件时间

audio.transcript: All budget forms must be submitted by Friday noon for review.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。All budget forms must be submitted by Friday noon 中，by 和 must be submitted 一起把 Friday noon 锁定为提交截止点。时间类细节题不能只记一个时点，要把它和控制的动作绑定。B 把 for review 误读成 review 开始时间；C、D 都没有原句依据。
tips: by + 时间通常表示截止点。
时间答案最好记成“什么时候 + 做什么”。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 识别 by 引出的时间截止点

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户把时间和事件动作绑定，避免把截止时间错当开始时间或复习时间。

front.text: 听完后，选出 briefing 最终开始时间。
front.task_prompt: 一句里有两个时间时，先判断哪个是旧计划，哪个是 moved to 后的新安排。

task_schema.action: 选择更新后的最终时间
task_schema.success_criteria: 能区分原计划时间和更新后真正生效的时间

audio.transcript: The briefing was supposed to start at six, but it has been moved to six-thirty because the inspection team is running late.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 B。was supposed to start at six 表示原计划时间；but it has been moved to six-thirty 才是更新后的生效时间。时间题里，supposed to、originally、planned 往往标记旧安排，moved to、delayed until、rescheduled for 后面才是新答案。A 是旧计划，C、D 是无依据干扰项。
tips: 听到 moved to，前一个时间通常要降级为旧安排。
双时间句先贴状态：原计划 / 新安排。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 区分原计划时间和更新后时间

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户识别时间修正信号，避免被最先出现的旧时间带偏。

front.text: 听完后，选出 8:15 发生的事。
front.task_prompt: 时间出现后继续追动作；不要只记时间点，要判断它对应的事件。

options.text: The shuttle leaves from the east gate.
The shuttle arrives at the east gate.
The east gate closes to visitors.

task_schema.success_criteria: 能选出目标时间对应的事件，并排除相近动作干扰

audio.transcript: The shuttle for visiting students leaves at eight-fifteen from the east gate.

analysis.text: 正确答案是 A。The shuttle for visiting students leaves at eight-fifteen from the east gate 中，eight-fifteen 绑定的是 leaves，因此它是班车发车时间。时间题经常把 arrives、opens、closes 这类相近事件做干扰；如果只记 8:15，不记 leaves，就会丢掉可作答信息。B、C、D 都偷换了事件动作。
tips: 时间后至少再追一个动作动词。
把答案复述成“8:15 发车”，比只记“8:15”更稳。

quality_metadata.main_training_goal: 绑定具体时点与发生事件

material.source_note: Legacy content_pool transcript with unverified provenance; sample only.

quality_metadata.exam_value: 训练用户把时间和动作事件绑定，减少把出发、到达、开放、关闭等相邻事件混淆的错误。
